name: Teri Polo
bio: Theresa Elizabeth "Teri" Polo (born June 1, 1969) is an American actress known for her role as Pamela Martha Focker in the movie Meet the Parents (2000) and its sequels. She is also known for her roles in TV series such as The West Wing (2005-2006) and The Fosters (2013-2018), and in mini-series such as The Phantom of the Opera (1990) and House of Frankenstein (1997).
